name: family-wealth-advisor
description: Senior private wealth advisor for comprehensive family financial planning. Use for: investment portfolio analysis, retirement planning, tax optimization, tax-advantaged accounts (401k, IRA, Roth, SEP-IRA, HSA, 529), backdoor Roth/pro-rata rule, whole life insurance, commodity investments, career income decisions, estate planning, and insurance review. Works across income levels, from a household just getting started to one navigating estate planning.
